config.note: Scale-up experiment: same benchmark config at 10k (committed benchmark.json), 30k, and 50k accounts. 10k values copied from results/benchmark.json (medium). 30k/50k runs use the external generator at scale 0.003/0.005.

verdict: Ranking quality degrades as the graph grows at fixed ring count: AP falls 0.079 -> 0.023 -> 0.009 (10k/30k/50k) and ring recall collapses at 50k (0.168). The planted rings become a smaller fraction of a much larger normal population, so the top-k that matters to an investigator fills with normal accounts. Edge AUC stays ~1.0: the per-transaction head still detects ring transfers trivially. Cost grows sharply (11 min -> 59 min wall clock on laptop CPU). Interpretation: discovering unseen rings is a search problem that gets harder with scale unless ring priors (size, burstiness) are modeled explicitly.
